passages.title: Moving into a Shared Apartment
passages.text: Last September I moved into a shared apartment with two other students. The rooms were small, {because} the building was more than a hundred {years} old. At breakfast my roommates made eggs, and we talked about our {classes} for a long time. They showed me the cheapest {market} for vegetables and how to use the washing {machine}. After one {week} the apartment already felt like {home}. I still live there and I am very happy.

passages.title: How to Spend Less at the Supermarket

Buy rice and pasta in large {bags}, and check the {date} on anything fresh. {Finally}, keep every {receipt} and count what you spent. These small habits add up faster than you think.

passages.title: Why We Feel Sleepy After Lunch
passages.text: Almost everyone knows the heavy feeling that arrives in the early afternoon. Many people {blame} their lunch, but scientists say the main {reason} is the body {clock}. Between one and three our body temperature falls, which makes concentration more {difficult}. A big meal makes the feeling {worse}, especially with a lot of sugar. But the same tiredness {appears} in people who eat nothing at all. More coffee is not the answer, because caffeine {stays} in the body for hours and {disrupts} sleep. A walk outside, bright light and cold water {help} much more. Even twenty minutes of {rest} improves memory. That afternoon dip is normal, not a sign of laziness.

passages.title: Working Across Time Zones
passages.text: More and more companies now employ people who live thousands of kilometers apart. The arrangement saves money and gives staff {flexibility}, but it creates problems that managers often {underestimate}. When a team is spread over three {continents}, there is rarely an hour when everybody is {awake} at once. {Instead} of long video meetings, the best teams write short updates that colleagues can read {whenever} they start work. The greatest danger is not technology but {isolation}: remote workers can go for days without a real {conversation}. Careful managers therefore {rotate} the meeting time, so that the same people are not always online at {midnight}. Distance is not the problem; silence is.

passages.title: What Happens to Old Phones
passages.text: Every year the world throws away more than a billion mobile phones. Only a small {percentage} is recycled, {despite} the gold, silver and other valuable {metals} inside every handset. The rest sits in {drawers}, kept by owners who are {afraid} that their personal {data} can still be read. Others are shipped abroad, where the plastic is burned and dangerous smoke {drifts} over nearby towns. Recycling old handsets produces more gold than mining the same weight of {rock}. Some makers now pay customers to {return} old models, and a few sell batteries that can be {replaced} at home. The simplest step is to keep a working phone one more year.

passages.title: Why Small Cinemas Survived Streaming
passages.text: When streaming services arrived, experts predicted the end of the small local cinema. Ten years later many of them are still open, {whereas} several large multiplexes have {closed}. These cinemas stopped competing on new films and started selling what a home screen cannot {offer}: an evening among other {people}. They show {classics} with live music, invite {directors} to answer {questions}, and rent the hall to schools. The audience pays for the event {rather} than the film, so tickets can cost {more} than a monthly subscription. Many also survive {thanks} to volunteers who sell tickets and clean the seats. The lesson is simple: they now sell an experience, not a film.

passages.title: Testing a Low-Cost Fitness Tracker
passages.text: I wore this cheap fitness tracker every day for two months. The step count proved {reliable}, differing from my phone by about two percent. Heart rate is another story: during fast running the numbers {jumped} and then fell {again}. Battery life is the strongest feature, {since} a single {charge} lasted eleven days. The strap is {comfortable}, {although} the plastic looked old after six weeks. Sleep tracking counts any hour in bed as sleep, so the results are {useless}. The app needs no monthly {subscription}, unlike many {competitors}. For a beginner who wants to walk more, it is good value.

idea_options: The museum's cafe generated complaints about noise from visitors.

Museums should spend more money on sound than on lighting.
Visitors remember a gallery mainly because of the objects it displays.

How Museums Choose Their Objects
Why Museums Are Losing Money
The Sound You Are Not Supposed to Hear

layered ماضي، والدليل داخل نفس الجملة: when the gallery reopened last year، يعني الشغل صار وخلص. و pitched اسم مفعول يصف recordings يعني «تسجيلات مضبوطة على مستوى معين»، وما نحتاج فعل ثاني مصرّف بعد layered.

scenarios.scenario: You are speaking with the university librarian, Mr. Carter, about a book you borrowed for your economics essay. Another student has requested the same book, so the library wants it back on Monday, but your essay is not due until Friday. You need to ask whether you can keep it a few more days or find another copy.

complete.q: What do you want to ask the librarian to do?
complete.answer: To keep it longer, or find another copy

options: Hello, I would like to buy this economics book from the library, please.
Hello, could you tell me if the printers on the second floor are working?
Hello, I got a message about the economics book I borrowed. It says I have to return it on Monday.
I am not bringing this book back on Monday, and that is final.
turns.why_ar: الافتتاحية الصح تستخدم نفس كلمات السيناريو: economics book و return it on Monday، فتوضح سبب كلامك من أول جملة.

turns.partner: That is right. Another student has placed a hold on it, so it has to come back Monday morning. Is that a problem for you?
options: It is, a little. My economics essay is due on Friday, so I still need the book for a few more days.
Monday is fine. I am not taking any classes this semester anyway.
Well, that student can wait. I borrowed it first.
Actually, could you also show me where the science section is?
turns.why_ar: سألك إذا فيه مشكلة، فالجواب الصح يشرح السبب بصراحة: البحث يوم الجمعة ومحتاج الكتاب كم يوم زيادة. باقي الخيارات إما تناقض السيناريو أو تغيّر الموضوع أو أسلوبها قاسي.

turns.partner: I see. I cannot extend the loan, but there is an ebook version, and a second paper copy at the science campus library.
options: That is useless. You should just tell the other student to wait until Friday.
So can I keep the paper copy until Friday, then?
Great. Could you deliver the second copy to my apartment today?
The ebook sounds easier for me. How do I get access to it?
turns.why_ar: قال لك ما يقدر يمدد بس فيه حلين، فالرد الصح يختار حل ويسأل عن الخطوة الجاية. الخيار الثاني يتجاهل كلامه، والثالث يطلب شي مستحيل، والأول قاسي.

turns.partner: You just log in with your student number on the library website. The ebook allows three readers at the same time.
options: Thank you. I will log in tonight and bring the paper copy back on Monday.
I do not have a student number. I am only visiting the city for a week.
Three readers at a time? That is a ridiculous system.
By the way, how late does the café downstairs stay open?
turns.why_ar: الرد الصح يؤكد الخطوتين اللي اتفقتوا عليهم: تسجّل الدخول وترجّع النسخة الورقية الاثنين. الخيار الثاني يناقض إنك طالب في الجامعة.

turns.partner: Perfect. If you have any trouble logging in, come back to the desk and I will reset your account.
options: Fine, but I still think you should have given me an extension.
Thanks a lot for your help. I will come and find you if the login does not work.
Actually, I have decided not to write the essay at all.
Could you reset my university email password as well?
turns.why_ar: الإغلاق المهذب يشكر ويوافق على العرض اللي قدّمه لك. لا تفتح موضوع جديد ولا ترجع تشتكي بعد ما انحلت المشكلة.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I spoke with the university librarian, Mr. Carter, about an economics book I had borrowed. He explained that another student had reserved it, so it had to come back on Monday, although my essay was not due until Friday. He could not extend the loan, but he told me about an ebook version. I agreed to use the ebook and to return the paper copy on Monday.
scenarios.summary_ar: لازم ملخصك يذكر: مع مين تكلمت (أمين المكتبة)، وش المشكلة (طالب ثاني حاجز الكتاب ولازم ترجعه الاثنين والبحث حقك الجمعة)، ووش الحل (نسخة إلكترونية بحساب الجامعة). كل الأفعال بالماضي، وابدأ بـ In this conversation, I spoke with...

scenarios.scenario: You are calling your landlord, Mr. Brooks, about the air conditioning in your apartment. It stopped working two days ago, the weather is very hot, and his usual technician cannot come before next week. You want the problem fixed before Saturday because your family is visiting, and you also need to know who pays for the repair.

complete.q: What is the problem in the apartment?
When do you need the repair finished?

options: Hello Mr. Brooks, I just wanted to say that everything in the apartment works perfectly.
Hello Mr. Brooks, this is your tenant in apartment twelve. The air conditioning stopped working two days ago.
Mr. Brooks, if the air conditioning is not fixed today, I am not paying the rent.
Hello Mr. Brooks, I am calling to ask if I can paint the kitchen wall.
turns.why_ar: أول جملة لازم تقول مين أنت ووش المشكلة بالضبط، بنفس كلمات السيناريو: air conditioning stopped working two days ago.

turns.partner: Oh, I am sorry to hear that. The technician I usually call is fully booked until next Wednesday.
options: Then find somebody else immediately. This is your job, not mine.
Wednesday is fine. I will be away all month anyway.
That is a bit late for me. My family is arriving on Saturday, and the apartment gets very hot.
Can you also change the lock on the front door while he is here?
turns.why_ar: قال لك الفني مشغول لين الأربعاء، فالرد الصح يشرح ليش هذا متأخر: أهلك جايين السبت. لا تضيف طلبات جديدة ولا تناقض نفسك.

turns.partner: I understand. I could call a different company, but they charge more. Would you be willing to share the cost with me?
options: Sure, I can share the cost, but I can only pay after my family leaves in two weeks.
No. Repairs are always the owner's responsibility, so please do not ask me again.
Cost? I already told you the fridge was broken too.
I would rather not pay all of it, but I could pay half if the work is done before Saturday.
turns.why_ar: طلب منك تشاركه التكلفة، فالرد الصح يوافق على نص المبلغ ويربطه بالشرط المهم عندك: قبل السبت. الخيار الأول يوافق بس يأجّل الدفع أسبوعين، وهذا ما ينفع مع موعد أهلك.

turns.partner: That sounds fair. I will ask them to come on Friday morning. Will somebody be at home to let them in?
options: Yes, I can stay at home on Friday morning and open the door for them.
No, nobody will be there, but they can come inside anyway.
Friday? I thought we agreed on Saturday.
Could you send me the technician's phone number and his home address?
turns.why_ar: سؤال مباشر: هل فيه أحد بالبيت؟ فالجواب الصح نعم مع تحديد الوقت. الخيار الثالث يتجاهل إن الاتفاق صار على الجمعة.

turns.partner: Good. I will confirm the exact time by message tonight, and you can pay your half to the technician directly.
options: Thanks, but I have changed my mind. I do not want the repair any more.
Fine, but next time answer your phone faster.
Thank you. I will wait for your message and have my half ready on Friday.
Will you pay my electricity bill this month as well?
turns.why_ar: الإغلاق الصح يعيد الخطوتين اللي قالها: تستنى الرسالة وتجهّز نصيبك من المبلغ يوم الجمعة.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I called my landlord, Mr. Brooks, because the air conditioning in my apartment had stopped working. He said his usual technician was busy until Wednesday, but I explained that my family was arriving on Saturday. We agreed that he would call a more expensive company and that I would pay half. A technician from that company was booked for Friday morning, and I promised to be at home.
scenarios.summary_ar: قل مع مين تكلمت (المالك مستر بروكس)، والمشكلة (المكيّف خربان والفني مشغول لين الأربعاء)، والاتفاق (شركة ثانية يوم الجمعة الصبح وتتقاسمون التكلفة). سطرين بالماضي يكفون.

scenarios.scenario: You work part-time at a supermarket, and you are speaking with your manager, Ms. Novak. You are scheduled to work on Thursday evening, but your final exam has been moved to Thursday afternoon in another city. You need to swap the shift with a colleague, and the schedule is locked on Tuesday at noon.

complete.q: Why can you not work on Thursday evening?

options: Hi Ms. Novak, thanks for changing my shift last Thursday.
Hi Ms. Novak, could I talk to you about a pay rise?
Ms. Novak, I will not be coming on Thursday. I have already told the others.
Hi Ms. Novak, do you have a moment? I have a problem with my Thursday evening shift.
turns.why_ar: افتح بأدب واذكر المشكلة نفسها: Thursday evening shift. لا تعلن قرارك جاهز ولا تفتح موضوع ثاني.

turns.partner: Of course. What is wrong? You are on the till from five until ten.
options: My final exam was moved to Thursday afternoon, and it is in another city, so I cannot be back by five.
Yes, five until ten is perfect for me.
I just do not feel like working evenings any more.
Actually, I would prefer to work in the bakery section instead.
turns.why_ar: سألتك وش المشكلة، فالجواب الصح يشرح السبب الحقيقي من السيناريو: الاختبار يوم الخميس بعد الظهر وفي مدينة ثانية.

turns.partner: I see. The schedule is locked on Tuesday at noon, so any change has to be agreed before then.
options: Can you just change it on Wednesday? Nobody will notice.
Tuesday is my day off, so I do not need to do anything.
Understood. I will ask Sara if she can take my hours and let you know by Monday evening.
Why does this company have so many pointless rules?
turns.why_ar: أعطتك موعد نهائي، فالرد الصح يحترمه ويقترح خطوة عملية قبله. الخيار الأول يطلب كسر النظام والثاني يتجاهل الكلام.

turns.partner: That works. If Sara agrees, send me a message and I will approve the swap in the system.
options: So I do not need to find anyone, then?
Could you call Sara yourself? I do not have time today.
Perfect. I will take the whole week off as well.
Great. I will message you as soon as she replies, and I will cover one of her weekend shifts in return.
turns.why_ar: الرد الصح يوافق على الخطوة اللي طلبتها ويزيد شي عادل: تغطي وردية لسارة بالمقابل. هذا يرفع درجتك في الاستجابة.

turns.partner: Good luck with your exam. But remember, if nobody swaps with you, you are still on the schedule.
options: That is not fair. My studies are more important than this job.
I understand. If Sara cannot do it, I will ask someone else before Tuesday noon.
Do not worry, I will simply call in sick that day.
By the way, when are the new uniforms arriving?
turns.why_ar: حذرتك من نتيجة واضحة، فالرد الصح يعترف بالمسؤولية ويعطي خطة بديلة قبل الموعد النهائي.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I spoke with my manager, Ms. Novak, about my Thursday evening shift. I explained that my final exam had been moved to Thursday afternoon in another city, so I could not be back by five. She reminded me that the schedule was locked on Tuesday at noon, so I promised to ask Sara to take my hours. I also offered to cover one of her weekend shifts.
scenarios.summary_ar: الملخص الكامل لازم يشمل: مديرتك مس نوفاك، ورديتك يوم الخميس، سبب الاعتذار (اختبار نهائي بمدينة ثانية)، والقرار (تبدّل مع سارة وترسل رسالة قبل ثلاثاء الظهر). كله بصيغة الماضي.

scenarios.scenario: You are calling the health center to change an appointment with Dr. Powell. Your check-up is booked for Wednesday at nine, but your bus to work leaves at half past eight and you cannot miss it. The receptionist says the clinic is very busy this week, and any cancellation must be made at least twenty-four hours in advance.

complete.answer: The receptionist at the health center

complete.q: Why do you want to change the appointment?
complete.answer: My bus to work leaves at half past eight

complete.q: How much notice does the clinic need for a cancellation?

options: Good morning. I would like to change my appointment with Dr. Powell on Wednesday morning, please.
Good morning. I need Dr. Powell to call me back in the next ten minutes.
Good morning. Could you tell me how much a dental cleaning costs?
Good morning. I would like to cancel all my appointments and change doctors.
turns.why_ar: الافتتاحية الصح واضحة ومؤدبة وتذكر الاسم والوقت: appointment with Dr. Powell on Wednesday morning.

turns.partner: Let me check for you. Yes, you are booked for Wednesday at nine with Dr. Powell. May I ask why you need to change it?
options: I cannot remember why I booked it. Could you tell me?
Nine o'clock is fine. I only wanted to confirm the address.
My bus to work leaves at half past eight, so I cannot be at the clinic at nine.
Could you also tell me whether the pharmacy next door opens on Fridays?
turns.why_ar: سألتك ليش، فالجواب الصح يعطي السبب الحقيقي من السيناريو: الباص يمشي الثامنة والنص. الخيار الأول يرجّع السؤال عليها وما يعطي أي سبب.

turns.partner: I understand. The doctor is fully booked this week, but I have a free slot next Tuesday at five in the afternoon.
options: Next Tuesday at five? Could you ask another patient to come later instead?
Five in the afternoon on Tuesday works well for me, because I finish work at four.
Actually, I would prefer Wednesday at nine after all.
Perfect, and could the doctor email me my results tonight?
turns.why_ar: عرضت عليك موعد محدد، فالرد الصح يقبله ويشرح ليش مناسب. الخيار الثالث يتجاهل كل الكلام السابق.

turns.partner: Good, I will move you to Tuesday. Please remember that if you cancel again, we need twenty-four hours' notice.
options: Twenty-four hours is far too strict for people who work.
So I can still cancel on Tuesday morning, then?
In that case, please book me for every Tuesday this year.
Of course. If anything changes, I will call you at least a day before.
turns.why_ar: ذكرت لك القاعدة، فالرد الصح يوافق عليها بكلماتك أنت: at least a day before = twenty-four hours.

turns.partner: You are all set. You will receive a text message with the new time this afternoon.
options: Thank you very much. I will look out for the message and see you next Tuesday.
Thanks, but I do not have a phone, so please send a letter instead.
Finally. That took much longer than it should have.
One more thing: could I get a copy of my brother's medical records?
turns.why_ar: الإغلاق الصح يشكر ويأكد إنك بتنتظر الرسالة وبتحضر الموعد. الخيار الثاني يعقّد الترتيب بعد ما خلص كل شي.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I called the health center to change my check-up with Dr. Powell. I explained that my bus to work left at half past eight, so nine o'clock was too early for me. The receptionist offered me a free place next Tuesday at five. I accepted the new time and agreed to give twenty-four hours' notice if I ever needed to cancel.
scenarios.summary_ar: اذكر: اتصلت بالمركز الصحي عشان تغيّر موعد الفحص، السبب (الباص يمشي ٨:٣٠)، والبديل اللي وافقت عليه (الثلاثاء الساعة ٥)، وقاعدة الإلغاء قبل ٢٤ ساعة. اكتبه بالماضي بجمل قصيرة.

scenarios.scenario: You are talking to Omar, a student in your engineering study group. The group meets on Sunday evenings, but the room you usually book is closed for repairs, and three members cannot travel to campus at night. Your mid-term test is in ten days, so you want to agree on a new place or move the meeting online.

complete.q: Why can the group not use the usual room?

options: Hi Omar, thanks for booking our room for Sunday evening.
Hi Omar, can we talk about Sunday? Our usual room is closed for repairs, and the test is in ten days.
Hi Omar, I have decided the group is finished. Everyone should study alone now.
Hi Omar, did you watch the football match last night?
turns.why_ar: الافتتاحية الصح تربط المشكلة بالوقت الضيق: الغرفة مقفلة والاختبار بعد عشرة أيام. هذي نفس كلمات السيناريو.

turns.partner: Oh, I did not know that. Should we look for another room, or do you have a better idea?
options: You are the one who lost the room, so you should fix it.
A room would be nice, but I am more worried about the final project.
Three of us cannot come to campus at night, so maybe we should meet online instead.
Let us just cancel the group until after the test.
turns.why_ar: سألك عن فكرة أفضل، فالرد الصح يقدّم اقتراح ويشرح السبب (ثلاثة ما يقدرون يجون بالليل). الخيار الأخير يلغي الهدف كله.

turns.partner: Online could work. But some of us have weak internet at home on Sunday evenings.
options: Weak internet is not a real excuse these days.
Then let us meet online but keep the cameras off, so the connection stays stable.
Perfect, so we will meet in the usual room as always.
By the way, do you know our professor's office hours?
turns.why_ar: طرح مشكلة تقنية، فالرد الصح يحل نفس المشكلة بحل عملي (نقفل الكاميرات). الخيار الثالث يتجاهل إن الغرفة مقفلة.

turns.partner: Cameras off is a good idea. What time should we start? Some people do not finish work until seven.
options: If they are late, we will not wait for them.
Let us start at six. They can leave work earlier.
How long do you think the mid-term will be?
Let us start at eight, then, so everyone has time to get home and eat something.
turns.why_ar: السؤال عن الوقت، والرد الصح يختار ساعة تناسب اللي يخلصون دوام الساعة سبع. الخيار الثاني يطلب شي مستحيل.

turns.partner: Eight works for me. I will send the link to the group chat tonight and remind everyone on Saturday.
options: Thanks, Omar. I will prepare practice questions on chapters four and five before Sunday.
Thanks, but I probably will not join. I study better alone.
Send it to me only. The others do not really need it.
Could you do my part of the group project as well?
turns.why_ar: أفضل إغلاق يشكر ويلتزم بمهمة واضحة قبل الأحد، فتبيّن إنك عضو متعاون في المجموعة.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I talked to Omar from my engineering study group about our Sunday meeting. I told him that our usual room was closed for repairs and that three members could not come to campus at night. Because our mid-term test was only ten days away, we decided to meet online at eight with the cameras off. I promised to prepare practice questions.
scenarios.summary_ar: لازم تذكر: تكلمت مع عمر من مجموعة المذاكرة، المشكلة (الغرفة مقفلة وثلاثة ما يقدرون يجون بالليل والاختبار بعد ١٠ أيام)، والقرار (اجتماع أونلاين الساعة ٨ والكاميرات مقفلة). كله بصيغة الماضي.

scenarios.scenario: You are speaking with your team leader, Hana, about the new company website. The design is ready, but the translation of the product pages is not finished, and the site is supposed to go live on the first of next month. Two people from your team are on holiday, so you need to decide together what to do.

complete.answer: The translation of the product pages

complete.q: Which part of the website is ready?

options: Hi Hana, the website is completely finished, so we can all relax now.
Hi Hana, when are we getting new office chairs?
Hi Hana, do you have five minutes? I am worried about the translation before the website launch.
Hana, the translation is late and it is clearly somebody's fault. Who was it?
turns.why_ar: افتح بطلب وقت قصير واذكر القلق بالضبط: التّرجمة قبل إطلاق الموقع. لا تبدأ بلوم أحد.

turns.partner: Yes, I read your note. How many product pages still need to be translated?
options: Around twenty product pages are still not translated, and two of the team are on holiday.
I am not sure, but the design really does look beautiful.
All of them are finished, actually.
I do not count pages. That is not part of my job.
turns.why_ar: سؤال بالأرقام يبي جواب بالأرقام: عشرين صفحة، وزميلين في إجازة. الخيار الثاني يتهرب والثالث يناقض السيناريو.

turns.partner: That is a lot. Do you think we should delay the launch, or publish the English pages first?
options: Let us delay the launch by six months, just to be safe.
Neither. Marketing should decide this, not us.
Actually, could we talk about my holiday request instead?
I would publish the English pages on the first and add the translations later in the month.
turns.why_ar: خيّرتك بين حلّين، فالرد الصح يختار واحد بوضوح ويضيف خطة زمنية. الخيار الأول مبالغ فيه والثاني يرمي المسؤولية.

turns.partner: I like that. Can you have the English pages checked and ready by Thursday?
options: You always ask me at the last minute.
Yes, I can check them by Thursday if I pause the newsletter this week.
Yes, and I will finish all the translations by Thursday too.
Which pages do you mean? I thought we were delaying everything.
turns.why_ar: الجواب المهني يوافق ويوضح الشرط الواقعي (توقف النشرة هالأسبوع). الخيار الثالث وعد مستحيل والرابع يتجاهل القرار اللي توّه انتهى.

turns.partner: That is fine, the newsletter can wait. I will tell the client that the other languages will come later.
options: Thanks, but please do not tell the client anything.
Okay, and I will take Friday off, since the work will be done.
So should I start translating the pages myself tonight?
Great. I will send you the checked pages on Thursday morning with a short list of what is still missing.
turns.why_ar: الإغلاق القوي يحدد وش بتسلّم ومتى: صفحات مراجعة صباح الخميس مع قائمة الناقص. هذا يثبت إنك فاهم القرار.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I spoke with my team leader, Hana, about the launch of the new company website. I told her that about twenty product pages were still not translated and that two colleagues were on holiday. We decided to publish the English pages on time and add the other languages later. I agreed to check them by Thursday, and Hana said she would tell the client.
scenarios.summary_ar: الملخص لازم يوضح: قائدة الفريق هنا، المشكلة (٢٠ صفحة بدون ترجمة وزميلين في إجازة والإطلاق أول الشهر)، والقرار (ينشرون الإنجليزي في وقته والترجمة بعدين). استخدم الماضي وأدوات ربط زي because و so.

scenarios.scenario: You are meeting your academic advisor, Dr. Wells, about your course plan for next semester. The calculus course you need is full, and registration closes on Friday. Without that course you cannot take the research module in the spring, and you also work three afternoons a week, so your timetable is very limited.

complete.q: What is the problem with your course plan?

options: Good morning, Dr. Wells. Please add me to the calculus course right now.
Good morning, Dr. Wells. I need advice about registration, because the calculus course I need is already full.
Good morning. Could you write me a job reference by tomorrow?
Good morning. I have decided to leave the program.
turns.why_ar: الافتتاحية الصح تطلب نصيحة وتذكر المشكلة: مادة التفاضل ممتلئة. لا تطلب منه يسجّلك بالقوة.

turns.partner: Let me look at the system. Yes, all the seats are taken. Have you thought about the evening section on Mondays?
options: Evening classes are a terrible idea for everybody.
No, I would rather wait until next year.
Do you know if the calculus exam is difficult?
I had not seen that section. Monday evening is free for me, because I only work in the afternoons.
turns.why_ar: اقترح عليك شعبة مسائية، فالرد الصح يفحصها مقابل ظروفك (تشتغل بعد الظهر بس). الخيار الثاني يخالف إن التسجيل يقفل الجمعة.

turns.partner: Good. But the evening section has a waiting list of six students, and places open only when somebody drops the course.
options: Then please put me on the waiting list today, and I will look for a second option as well.
Six students? Could you move me to the top of the list?
That is fine. I will register on Saturday and see what happens.
Is the waiting list the same for the online literature course?
turns.why_ar: المعلومة إن القائمة طويلة، فالرد الذكي يسجّل في القائمة ويجهّز خطة ب. الخيار الثالث مستحيل لأن التسجيل يقفل الجمعة.

turns.partner: That is sensible. If no place opens by Thursday, you could take data analysis instead; it counts for the same requirement.
options: Why did you not tell me about that course two weeks ago?
So the research module is not necessary any more?
That helps a lot. If I hear nothing by Thursday, I will register for data analysis before Friday.
Can I register for both courses and decide in December?
turns.why_ar: أعطاك بديل وشرط زمني، فالرد الصح يعيد الشرط بكلماتك: لو ما فيه مقعد لين الخميس، تسجّل data analysis قبل الجمعة.

turns.partner: Exactly. Send me an email once you have registered, so I can update your file.
options: Could you register for me and send the email yourself?
Thanks, but I never use email.
By the way, could you increase my scholarship?
I will. Thank you for your time, Dr. Wells. I will email you as soon as it is done.
turns.why_ar: طلب منك إيميل بعد التسجيل، فالإغلاق الصح يوعد بالإيميل ويشكره. لا تحوّل المهمة عليه ولا تفتح موضوع المنحة.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I met my academic advisor, Dr. Wells, because the calculus course I needed was full and registration closed on Friday. Dr. Wells suggested the Monday evening section, but it already had a waiting list of six students. We agreed that I would join the list and take data analysis instead if no place opened by Thursday. I promised to send an email after I registered.
scenarios.summary_ar: اذكر: مرشدك الأكاديمي دكتور ويلز، المشكلة (مادة التفاضل ممتلئة والتسجيل يقفل الجمعة)، والخطة (قائمة انتظار للشعبة المسائية وبديل data analysis قبل الخميس). لا تنسى تكتب كل شي بالماضي.

scenarios.scenario: You are speaking with Mr. Oliveira, the coordinator of your summer internship at an engineering company. The internship starts on the third of June, but your last exam is on the fifth and you cannot miss it. The company needs your answer by the end of this week, because they must order a laptop and a security badge for you.

complete.q: What is the problem with the starting date?
complete.answer: My last exam is on the fifth

complete.q: What does the company need to order for you?
complete.answer: A laptop and a security badge

options: Hello Mr. Oliveira, thank you for the offer. I have a small problem with the starting date.
Hello Mr. Oliveira, I am afraid I cannot do the internship at all.
Hello, could you tell me what my salary will be in my second year?
Hello, I will start whenever it suits me, so do not worry about the date.
turns.why_ar: اشكره على الفرصة وبعدين اذكر المشكلة بهدوء: مشكلة صغيرة في تاريخ البداية. لا ترفض الفرصة ولا تتكلم بغرور.

turns.partner: No problem, tell me. We were planning to see you on the third of June with the rest of the group.
options: The third is perfect. I will be there in the morning.
I do not like the third of June, for personal reasons.
My last exam is on the fifth of June, so I could only start on the sixth.
Will there be a welcome lunch on the first day?
turns.why_ar: قال لك التاريخ المتوقع، فالرد الصح يعطي السبب والتاريخ البديل بدقة: اختبار يوم ٥، فأبدأ يوم ٦.

turns.partner: I see. The first two days are safety training, and unfortunately we cannot repeat that training for one person.
options: Then I will skip the training and start straight away with the real work.
Fine, I will miss my exam. The internship is more important.
How many students are joining the group this year?
Could I do the safety training with the next group, or complete it online before I arrive?
turns.why_ar: المشكلة صارت في التدريب، فالرد الصح يقترح حلّين ممكنين بدل ما يتنازل عن الاختبار أو يتجاهل النظام.

turns.partner: There is an online version, actually. If you complete it before you arrive, you can join the team on the sixth.
options: That is a great solution. I will finish the online training before the sixth and start that morning.
Perfect. Could you send somebody to my university to explain it to me?
So the safety training is not necessary, then?
Finally, something useful. You should have said that at the beginning.
turns.why_ar: قدّم لك الحل، فالرد الصح يقبله ويؤكد الالتزام بالتاريخ: أخلص التدريب قبل يوم ٦ وأبدأ الصبح.

turns.partner: Great. I will send the training link and order your laptop and badge today. Please confirm by email before Friday.
options: Thanks. I will confirm next month, when I know my exam results.
Could you order me a second laptop for home as well?
Thank you. I will send the confirmation email tomorrow, well before Friday.
You can order everything without my confirmation.
turns.why_ar: فيه موعد نهائي واضح (قبل الجمعة)، فالإغلاق الصح يوعد بالتأكيد قبله. الخيار الأول يتجاهل الموعد تمامًا.

scenarios.summary_model: In this conversation, I spoke with Mr. Oliveira, the coordinator of my summer internship. I explained that the internship began on the third of June, but my last exam was on the fifth. The first two days were safety training, so we agreed that I would do the online version before I arrived and join the team on the sixth. I promised to confirm by email before Friday.
scenarios.summary_ar: لازم يظهر في ملخصك: مع مين تكلمت (منسق التدريب مستر أوليفيرا)، التعارض (التدريب يبدأ ٣ يونيو واختبارك ٥ يونيو)، والحل (تدريب السلامة أونلاين وتلتحق يوم ٦ وتأكيد بالإيميل قبل الجمعة). اكتبه بالماضي في ٣ أو ٤ جمل.

items.text: There's a new coffee shop next to the train station.
items.trap_ar: There's = There is — الاختصار والصيغة الكاملة الاثنين مقبولين، بس لا تكتبها Theres بدون فاصلة عليا.

items.text: My sister walks to school every morning with her two friends.
items.trap_ar: walks لازم لها -s لأن الفاعل مفرد، وtwo بالحروف مو رقم ٢.

items.text: We don't have enough chairs for all the guests tonight.
items.trap_ar: don't بفاصلة عليا، وchairs وguests كلها جمع بـ -s.

items.text: He's looking for his phone under the kitchen table.
items.trap_ar: He's = He is بفاصلة عليا، وبعدها his phone ملكية بدون فاصلة — نفس الصوت تقريبًا وكتابة مختلفة.

items.text: I ate two eggs and drank a glass of milk this morning.
items.trap_ar: ماضي شاذ: ate مو eated، وdrank مو drinked، وtwo بالحروف مو too.

items.text: How much does a ticket to the science museum cost?
items.trap_ar: بعد does الفعل cost يجي بدون -s، والجملة تنتهي بعلامة استفهام.

items.text: There are several buses that go to the city center.
items.trap_ar: several يبيها جمع: buses بـ -es، وThere are مو There is.

items.text: The soup was too hot to eat, so I waited ten minutes.
items.trap_ar: too بمعنى «زيادة» بحرفين o، مو two ولا to، وفاصلة قبل so، وten بالحروف.

items.text: Their new house is over there beside the small park.
items.trap_ar: Their (ملكهم) في الأول وthere (هناك) بعدها — نفس النطق وكتابة مختلفة، وhouse مفرد.

items.text: Do you want tea or juice with your breakfast?
items.trap_ar: سؤال يبدأ بـ Do ولازم علامة استفهام في الآخر، مو نقطة.

items.text: My cousin bought a used car and drove it home yesterday.
items.trap_ar: ماضي شاذ: bought مو buyed، وdrove مو drived، وused بـ -ed.

items.text: The children's coats are still on the classroom floor.
items.trap_ar: children's ملكية والفاصلة العليا قبل الـ s لأن children جمع أصلاً (مو childrens')، وcoats جمع بدون فاصلة.

items.text: If you leave now, you'll arrive before the shops close.
items.trap_ar: جملة If في الأول تبي فاصلة بعدها، وyou'll = you will بفاصلة عليا.

items.text: Although the film was long, I enjoyed every single minute.
items.trap_ar: بعد جملة Although الافتتاحية حط فاصلة، وenjoyed بـ -ed مو enjoied.

items.text: She's already finished her assignment, hasn't she?
items.trap_ar: سؤال ذيل: فاصلة قبل hasn't she وعلامة استفهام في النهاية، وShe's = She has هنا.

items.text: The train arrives at a quarter past seven every evening.
items.trap_ar: arrives بـ -s، والوقت كله حروف: a quarter past seven مو 7:15.

items.text: We walked for two hours, and then we stopped for lunch.
items.trap_ar: walked وstopped بـ -ed (وstopped بحرفين p)، وفاصلة قبل and، وtwo بالحروف.

items.text: Nearly all of the students prefer studying in the library after lunch.
items.trap_ar: Nearly all of + جمع، فالفعل prefer بدون -s، وstudying بـ -ing، وstudents جمع.

items.text: He taught himself to cook by watching videos online.
items.trap_ar: taught ماضي شاذ من teach، وفيها gh صامتة، وhimself كلمة وحدة.

items.text: It's important to check the car and its battery before a long trip.
items.trap_ar: It's الأولى = It is بفاصلة عليا، وits الثانية ملكية بدون فاصلة — أشهر فخ في الاختبار.

items.text: I received a receipt for the shoes I returned last Thursday.
items.trap_ar: receipt فيها p صامتة، وreceived تنكتب ei بعد c، وreturned بـ -ed.

items.text: Even though he studied hard, he failed the driving test.
items.trap_ar: فاصلة بعد جملة Even though، وstudied بـ ied، وfailed بـ -ed.

items.text: A few of my colleagues cycle to work when the weather allows.
items.trap_ar: A few + جمع فالفعل cycle بدون -s، بس allows معها -s لأن weather مفرد.

items.text: They've been working on the same project since January.
items.trap_ar: They've = They have بفاصلة عليا، وworking بـ -ing، وJanuary بحرف كبير (مهم في الاختبار الحقيقي).

items.text: Do you think the price of electricity will rise again?
items.trap_ar: السؤال كامل يبي علامة استفهام حتى لو الجملة الثانية خبرية، وelectricity بـ c وليس s.

items.text: My laptop's screen cracked when it fell off the desk.
items.trap_ar: laptop's ملكية بفاصلة عليا (شاشة اللابتوب)، وfell ماضي شاذ، وcracked بـ -ed.

items.text: She wrote three emails and sent them before the meeting started.
items.trap_ar: wrote وsent ماضي شاذ، وstarted بـ -ed، وthree بالحروف.

items.text: There were too many people waiting, so we took a taxi.
items.trap_ar: too (زيادة) مو two، وtook ماضي شاذ، وفاصلة قبل so.

items.text: Would you mind repeating the address a little more slowly?
items.trap_ar: سؤال مهذب: بعد mind يجي repeating بـ -ing، وعلامة استفهام في الآخر.

items.text: He forgot his passport at home, so he missed his flight.
items.trap_ar: forgot ماضي شاذ، وmissed بحرفين s وبـ -ed، وفاصلة قبل so.

items.text: Several of my neighbors have installed solar panels this year.
items.trap_ar: Several + جمع فالفعل have مو has، وinstalled بحرفين l وبـ -ed.

items.text: The team's performance improved after it changed its training schedule.
items.trap_ar: team's ملكية بفاصلة عليا والفريق مفرد (it وits)، وits الثانية بدون فاصلة، وimproved وchanged بـ -ed.

items.text: This app tracks how many steps you take each day.
items.trap_ar: tracks بـ -s لأن الفاعل app مفرد، لكن take بدون -s لأن الفاعل you.

items.text: She works four days a week and studies on the weekend.
items.trap_ar: works وstudies كلها بـ -s (وstudies تنتهي بـ ies)، وfour بالحروف.

items.text: Nobody told us that the office would be closed on Monday.
items.trap_ar: told ماضي شاذ من tell، وclosed بـ -ed، وMonday بحرف كبير (مهم في الاختبار الحقيقي).

items.text: The rent increased by about ten percent last year.
items.trap_ar: increased بـ -ed، وten وpercent كلها حروف مو 10%.

items.text: Although she's afraid of heights, she climbed to the top.
items.trap_ar: فاصلة بعد جملة Although، وshe's = she is، وclimbed فيها b صامتة مع -ed.

items.text: Where are you planning to spend your summer holiday this year?
items.trap_ar: سؤال بـ Where وترتيب are you، وعلامة استفهام في النهاية.

items.text: Despite the traffic, we managed to reach the airport on time.
items.trap_ar: Despite بدون of وبعدها فاصلة، وmanaged بـ -ed.

items.text: The council's decision to close the library angered many local residents.
items.trap_ar: council's ملكية بفاصلة عليا، وresidents جمع بـ -s، وangered بـ -ed.

items.text: Researchers found that a lack of sleep affects concentration far more than most students realize.
items.trap_ar: affects فعل بـ -s (مو effects الاسم)، وfound ماضي شاذ من find، وrealize بدون -s لأن الفاعل students جمع.

items.text: While the island itself is small, it attracts thousands of visitors every summer.
items.trap_ar: island فيها s صامتة، وفاصلة بعد جملة While الافتتاحية، وattracts بـ -s، وthousands جمع.

items.text: It's worth noting that their proposal wasn't approved by the committee.
items.trap_ar: It's = It is، وtheir ملكية (مو there)، وwasn't بفاصلة عليا، وcommittee بحرفين m وحرفين t.

items.text: Even though the evidence seemed convincing, the committee remained unconvinced.
items.trap_ar: فاصلة بعد جملة Even though، وseemed وremained بـ -ed، وunconvinced بـ un في الأول.

items.text: Having reviewed the data, the analysts revised their earlier estimates.
items.trap_ar: الجملة تبدأ بـ Having + reviewed ولازم فاصلة بعدها، وanalysts وestimates جمع.

items.text: The airline's profits have doubled since it opened new routes to Asia.
items.trap_ar: airline's ملكية بفاصلة عليا وprofits جمع بدونها، وAsia بحرف كبير (مهم في الاختبار الحقيقي).

items.text: Two thirds of the participants completed the survey online last month.
items.trap_ar: الكسر بالحروف: two thirds مو 2/3، وcompleted بـ -ed، وparticipants جمع.

items.text: Rarely have I seen a city change so quickly in the space of five years.
items.trap_ar: بعد Rarely ينقلب الترتيب: have I seen، والفعل change بدون to، وfive بالحروف.

items.text: The report that was published last week contains several serious errors in its financial figures.
items.trap_ar: جملة that هنا بدون فواصل، وcontains بـ -s لأن report مفرد، وits ملكية بدون فاصلة، وerrors وfigures جمع.

items.text: If the city council does not intervene, house prices will keep rising sharply.
items.trap_ar: فاصلة بعد جملة If الافتتاحية، وdoes not = doesn't الاثنين مقبولين، وintervene بدون -s بعد does، وprices جمع.

items.text: Were the deadline extended by another two weeks, we could improve the design considerably.
items.trap_ar: جملة شرطية مقلوبة تبدأ بـ Were وتبيها فاصلة، وextended بـ -ed، وtwo وweeks بالحروف.

items.text: Traffic noise reduces average sleep by almost an hour in the busiest neighborhoods.
items.trap_ar: reduces بـ -s لأن noise مفرد، وan hour بـ h صامتة، وneighborhoods جمع بالكتابة الأمريكية.

items.text: She speaks three languages fluently, and she's now learning a fourth.
items.trap_ar: speaks بـ -s، وfluently بـ -ly، وshe's = she is، وفاصلة قبل and.

items.text: What surprised me most was how quickly the technology became obsolete.
items.trap_ar: surprised بـ -ed، وbecame ماضي شاذ من become، وobsolete تنتهي بـ -ete مو -ate، وأول مقطع obso- مو obse-.

items.text: The process looks simple, but its details take weeks to master.
items.trap_ar: its هنا ملكية بدون فاصلة عليا (مو it's)، وlooks بـ -s، وفاصلة قبل but.

items.text: The bridge's supports were badly weakened by decades of exposure to salt water and heavy traffic.
items.trap_ar: bridge's ملكية بفاصلة عليا، وsupports جمع بدونها، وweakened بـ -ed في المبني للمجهول، وdecades جمع.

items.text: The renovation is expected to take eighteen months and cost several million dollars.
items.trap_ar: eighteen بالحروف وفيها gh صامتة، وmonths جمع، وmillion بدون -s بعد several، لكن dollars بـ -s.

items.text: Given the rising cost of housing, more graduates are staying with their parents.
items.trap_ar: فاصلة بعد جملة Given الافتتاحية، وgraduates وparents جمع، وtheir مو there.

items.text: The interview lasted almost an hour, didn't it?
items.trap_ar: سؤال ذيل: فاصلة قبل didn't it وعلامة استفهام في الآخر، وlasted بـ -ed.

items.text: Whether or not the new policy succeeds depends largely on the support it receives locally.
items.trap_ar: succeeds وdepends وreceives كلها بـ -s، وWhether بـ Wh مو weather الطقس.

items.sentence: Every Friday my mother buys fresh fruit and fish at the local market near our house.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: buys fresh fruit and fish — المكان اللي تشتري منه الفواكه والسمك الطازج هو الـ market.

items.sentence: He rides his bicycle to work every day because parking a car downtown is very difficult.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: rides ... to work + parking a car is difficult — يعني يركب دراجة بدل السيارة.

items.sentence: My tooth hurt for three days, so I finally went to see the dentist on Sunday.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: My tooth hurt — اللي يعالج الأسنان هو الـ dentist مو أي دكتور ثاني.

items.sentence: I liked the leather jacket, but I did not buy it because it was too expensive.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: liked it but did not buy + too — السبب الوحيد المنطقي هو السعر الغالي.

items.sentence: The airline lost my luggage, so I had no clean clothes for the first three days.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: The airline lost ... no clean clothes — الشنط اللي فيها الملابس اسمها luggage.

items.sentence: I picked up my medicine from the pharmacy across the street from the main hospital.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: picked up my medicine — المكان اللي تاخذ منه الدواء هو الـ pharmacy.

items.sentence: Photography is my favorite hobby, and I take my camera with me on every trip.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: Photography ... favorite + I take my camera on every trip — شيء تسويه للمتعة يعني hobby.

items.sentence: The photos and videos on my phone used up all the storage, so I deleted the old ones.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: photos and videos ... so I deleted the old ones — المساحة اللي تنحفظ فيها الملفات اسمها storage.

items.sentence: We reached the airport two hours before our flight and checked in almost immediately.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: two hours before our flight + checked in — المكان اللي فيه رحلات وتسجيل وصول هو الـ airport.

items.sentence: Carrots, onions and peppers are the three vegetables I always keep in my fridge.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: Carrots, onions and peppers — هذي كلها أنواع خضار، فالكلمة لازم تكون vegetables.

items.sentence: We signed a two-year contract for the apartment, so we cannot move out before next summer.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: signed ... for two years ... cannot move out before next summer — الورقة الملزمة اللي توقّعها اسمها contract.

items.sentence: The company pays for a monthly subscription so that employees can use the metro for free.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: pays monthly ... so that employees can use the metro for free — الاشتراك الشهري اسمه subscription.

items.sentence: We canceled the summer trip because it simply did not fit into our family budget.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: canceled the trip ... did not fit into — المبلغ المحدد للصرف اسمه budget.

items.sentence: After rehearsing her speech ten times, she felt confident enough to present it without notes.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: rehearsing ten times ... present it without notes — التكرار أعطاها ثقة، يعني confident.

items.sentence: The new supermarket is very convenient because it opens early and is only five minutes away.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: opens early and is only five minutes away — يعني يسهّل عليك، وهذا معنى convenient.

items.sentence: The old printer breaks down every week, so the office needs a more reliable machine.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: breaks down every week — العكس المطلوب جهاز ما يخرب، يعني reliable.

items.sentence: The theater was full, and the audience clapped for almost five minutes after the final song.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: theater was full ... clapped after the final song — الناس اللي يحضرون ويصفقون هم الـ audience.

items.sentence: Keep your receipt, because the store will not exchange the shoes without proof of purchase.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: will not exchange ... without proof of purchase — ورقة إثبات الشراء اسمها receipt.

items.sentence: Our new apartment is completely empty, so we have to buy furniture before we move in.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: apartment is completely empty ... before we move in — الكنب والطاولات والسراير كلها furniture.

items.sentence: The traffic problem is serious, but nobody has suggested a practical solution during the last three meetings.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: The traffic problem ... nobody has suggested a practical — كلمة problem تفرض مقابلها solution.

items.sentence: I ordered the book online on Sunday evening, and delivery took only two working days.
items.clue_ar: القرينة: ordered online ... took only two working days — وقت وصول الطلب للبيت اسمه delivery.

items.sentence: She sent me an invitation to her wedding, but unfortunately I will be abroad that week.

sample.prompt: Describe a time when you helped someone you did not know. What was the situation? What exactly did you do? How did you feel afterwards?
sample.model_90: Last winter I helped an older woman I had never met at the train station near my office. She was standing next to the ticket machine looking confused, and she told me that her card had been rejected three times and her train was leaving in ten minutes. I stayed with her and tried the machine again with a different card. It still did not work, so I paid for her ticket myself and walked with her to the right platform, because the signs there are honestly not clear. Afterwards I felt genuinely happy, and also a little surprised at how small the favor was. It cost me about five dollars and seven minutes. Since that day I have tried to stop and ask when someone looks lost, instead of walking past and assuming that another person will help.

sample.prompt: Describe a time when your travel plans suddenly changed. Where were you going? What went wrong? How did you deal with the situation?
sample.model_90: Two years ago I was flying to Dubai for a three-day conference, and my plans fell apart at the airport. Where I was going was simple enough: a morning flight, a taxi to the hotel, and my session at two o'clock. What went wrong was that the flight was canceled because of a sandstorm, and the next available seat was twelve hours later. At first I was frustrated, but I dealt with it in a practical way. I called the organizers and asked them to record my session, I moved my hotel booking by one night, and I used the waiting time to finish a report I had been avoiding for weeks. I arrived late, but I did not lose the conference. Now I always book the earliest flight and keep a backup plan, because delays are normal, not unusual.

sample.prompt: Describe a time when you changed a habit in order to be healthier. What was the habit? What did you do to change it? Was the change difficult?
sample.model_90: About a year ago I decided to stop drinking energy drinks, which had become a real habit for me. I was having two or three cans a day at work, and I noticed that I could not fall asleep before two in the morning. To change it, I did not stop suddenly. In the first week I cut down to one can, then I replaced the second one with green tea, and I started walking for twenty minutes after lunch so that I felt awake without caffeine. Honestly, the change was difficult for about ten days. I had headaches and I was in a bad mood every afternoon. After that it became easy, and now the smell of those drinks actually puts me off. My sleep improved, and I save around forty dollars every month.

sample.prompt: Some companies pay for their employees to take courses and learn new skills. Do you think companies should do this? What are the benefits? Are there any risks for the company?
sample.model_90: I strongly believe that companies should pay for their employees' training. The first benefit is the quality of the work. When staff learn new tools, they make fewer mistakes and finish tasks faster, which saves the company money in the long run. The second benefit is loyalty. In the office where I work, my manager paid for an accounting course for two of my colleagues, and both of them are still with us four years later, because they felt that the company had invested in them. Of course, there is a risk. An employee can take an expensive course and then leave for a competitor with a higher salary. However, this risk is small compared with the cost of keeping people who never improve, and companies can ask employees to stay for one year after an expensive course.

sample.prompt: Some cities have made public transport free in the city center. Do you think this is a good idea? What would the advantages be? What problems could it cause?
sample.model_90: I think free public transport in city centers is a good idea, especially in places where traffic is a daily problem. The main advantage is that fewer people would drive. If buses and trams cost nothing, many drivers would leave their cars at home, so the air would be cleaner and parking would be easier for the people who really need it. A second advantage is fairness, because students and low-paid workers spend a large part of their money on tickets. There would be problems too. The city would lose the income from tickets, so it would need higher taxes or less money for other services, and buses could become extremely crowded at peak hours. In my view, a city should start with students and older people and then decide, using real numbers, whether to expand the idea.

sample.prompt: Many supermarkets now charge customers for plastic bags. Do you think this is an effective way to protect the environment? What else could supermarkets do?
sample.model_90: Charging for plastic bags is effective, but only in a limited way. It clearly changes behavior. After my local supermarket started charging, my mother bought two cloth bags and we have used the same ones for three years, and I see far fewer plastic bags in the street near our building. However, bags are a small part of the problem. Most of the plastic I bring home is the packaging around vegetables, water bottles, and frozen food, and a small charge does not touch that at all. Supermarkets could do much more. They could sell rice, nuts, and cleaning liquids from large containers so that customers refill their own bottles, offer a discount to people who bring bags, and stop wrapping bananas in plastic. In short, the charge is a good first step, not a solution.

sample.prompt: Some universities require every student to complete a work placement before graduating. Do you think this should be required for all students? Why or why not? What could students gain from it?
sample.model_90: I think a work placement should be required for most students, although universities need to be flexible. My main reason is that studying and working are very different experiences. A student can get excellent marks in marketing and still not know how to write a professional email or handle a difficult client, and three months in a real office teaches those things quickly. Students would also gain contacts and a much clearer idea of what they actually want. My cousin studied engineering and discovered during her placement that she preferred design to construction, so she changed her plan before it became expensive to change. The main problem is availability. In small cities there are not enough companies, so universities should accept volunteer work or long university projects instead. With that flexibility, the requirement is fair and useful.

sample.prompt: Some people save for years to buy a home, while others prefer to rent and use their money for other things. Which do you think is better? What are the reasons for your choice? What is one disadvantage?
sample.model_90: For me, buying a home is better in the long run, although renting suits some people. My first reason is stability. When you own the place, nobody can raise the rent suddenly or ask you to leave in two months, and you can paint a wall or change a kitchen without asking permission. My second reason is that rent money disappears completely, while the money you pay for a house stays with you as property. My uncle paid rent for eighteen years and today he owns nothing, which he regrets. The clear disadvantage is flexibility. Buying ties you to one city, and if a good job appears somewhere else, selling a house can take months. For a young person who may move for work, renting is smarter, but for a family that plans to stay, buying wins.

sample.prompt: Many clinics now offer video appointments instead of face-to-face visits. Do you think this is a good change for patients? What are the benefits? When is a face-to-face visit still necessary?
sample.model_90: Video appointments are a good change for patients, as long as they do not replace everything. The clearest benefit is time. Instead of driving to a clinic and waiting an hour in a room full of people, a patient can speak to a doctor from home in ten minutes. This matters most for people who live far from a hospital, for parents with small children, and for anyone with a simple question about a medicine or a test result. Lower cost is another benefit, because clinics can see more patients in a day. However, a face-to-face visit is still necessary when the doctor has to examine the body: chest pain, a serious injury, a strange lump, or a child with a high fever. A camera cannot listen to a heartbeat, so the two systems should work together.

sample.model_90: I agree that schools should teach practical subjects, because many young adults leave school without basic life skills. Personally, I think managing money is the most useful one. Almost everyone will have a salary, a bank account, and a phone contract, but nobody explains how instalment plans really cost you or how to plan a monthly budget. I learned about saving only after I lost money on a payment plan I did not understand at twenty-two. Cooking is also valuable, since students who can cook eat better and spend far less on delivery. Something would be lost, of course. The school week is already full, so a practical subject would take hours away from science or literature. My solution is to teach these skills in short weekly sessions rather than as a complete subject with exams.

الأنفع: إدارة الفلوس — كلنا بيصير عندنا راتب وحساب بنكي وعقد جوال، ومحد يشرح الأقساط والميزانية والتوفير.

interactive.prompt: Some companies have moved to a four-day working week with the same pay. Do you think this is a good idea? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You talked about rest and productivity. What about customers and services that people need on the fifth day? How could a company deal with that?
interactive.model1_90: I think a four-day working week with the same pay is a good idea for most office jobs. My first reason is that tired people are not productive. In my own job, my last two hours on Thursday are almost useless: I read the same email three times and I still make mistakes. If the week were shorter, those hours would simply disappear and the rest of the time would be more focused. My second reason is health. A third free day gives people time for exercise, for a doctor's appointment, and for their families, so they take fewer sick days. Companies in several countries have tested this and reported the same output with happier staff. For these reasons, I believe most offices should try a four-day week for six months and then measure the results.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, that is a fair concern, and it is exactly why a four-day week cannot be copied everywhere. Hospitals, shops, and airports must open every day, so those workers need better shifts rather than a shorter week. Even in an office, I would not close on the same day for everyone. Half the team could rest on Monday and half on Friday, so a customer always finds someone who can answer. If a company cannot cover its clients that way, it should keep five days and reduce overtime instead. The service comes first.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
ناقصك حوالي ١٥ كلمة؟ زيد ثلاث جمل جاهزة بس خلها طبيعية:
شرطية: If my company tested this for six months, I am sure the results would surprise the managers.
مبني للمجهول: In some countries the idea has already been tested by large companies.
جملة وصل: Employees who work fewer hours often produce better work than those who stay late every day.

interactive.prompt: Some schools have stopped organizing competitive sports days because weaker students feel embarrassed. Do you agree with this decision? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You mentioned motivation and learning how to lose. What about students who have a health problem or a disability? How should schools include them on a sports day?
interactive.model1_90: I disagree with this decision, because removing the competition does not remove the problem. My first reason is that children meet competition everywhere: in exams, in games, and later in job interviews. A sports day is a safe place to learn how to lose, try again, and clap for the winner. My second reason is motivation. When I was thirteen, I was the slowest runner in my class, and the annual race pushed me to train with my brother for a month. I still finished near the back, but I was fitter and I felt proud of myself. Instead of canceling sports day, schools should change it. They can add team relays, swimming, and fun events where speed is not everything, so that every child has a chance to succeed at something.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, those students should not be sitting on a bench watching, but that is a design problem, not a reason to cancel the whole day. Schools can add events that suit different bodies, such as archery, table tennis, or a wheelchair race, and they can give every student a role, even as a judge, a photographer, or a team captain. A short medical form a week before would tell the teachers exactly who needs a different activity. For me, inclusion means giving everybody something to win, not giving nobody anything.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
لو وقفت عند ١٠٥ كلمات، ضيف:
شرطية: If schools removed every competition, students would still compete in exams and later at work.
مبني للمجهول: In my old school, the races were organized by the students themselves.
جملة وصل: Children who lose sometimes learn more than children who always win.

interactive.prompt: Some people think that news websites should clearly label every article that was written by artificial intelligence. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You focused on trust and mistakes. Do you think a label would change how many people actually read those articles, and would that matter for news companies?
interactive.model1_90: I strongly agree that news websites should label articles written by artificial intelligence. My first reason is honesty. Readers decide how much to trust a story partly by knowing who wrote it, and hiding the author changes that decision. If a machine produced a report about a company's results, I want to know, in the same way that I want to know when a text is an advertisement. My second reason is responsibility. Software still invents details, and a label tells editors and readers where to check first when something is wrong. For example, a website I follow published an automatic summary of a football match with the wrong final score, and nobody noticed for hours. A small line at the top of the page costs nothing and protects the reader.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, probably yes, at least at the beginning. Many readers would skip an article marked as written by a machine, because it sounds cheap, so traffic on those pages would fall. For a news company that is a real cost, but I see it as useful pressure. If a label reduces readers, editors will either use the software only for simple things, such as weather and sports results, or check the text properly before publishing it. In a few years, I think people will care less about the label itself and more about whether the reporting is accurate.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
عشان توصل ١٢٠ كلمة زيد جملتين أو ثلاث:
شرطية: If a newspaper hid this information, I would stop trusting the rest of its articles too.
مبني للمجهول: Every automatic article should be checked by a human editor before publication.
جملة وصل: Readers who cannot see who wrote a story have no way to judge it.

interactive.prompt: Some restaurants have started charging customers who leave large amounts of food on their plates. Do you agree with this practice? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You talked about the customers. How could a restaurant reduce waste inside the kitchen itself, before the food even reaches the table?
interactive.model1_90: I agree with this practice, but mainly in buffet restaurants where people serve themselves. My first reason is that waste is a real cost. Food that goes into the bin has already used water, land, and fuel, and the restaurant also pays to throw it away, so a small charge makes people take a normal portion instead of filling three plates. My second reason is that it works. A buffet near my university introduced a two-dollar charge for uneaten food, and the staff told me that waste dropped by almost half in one month, while the number of customers stayed the same. In restaurants where the kitchen decides the portion, a charge would be unfair, so those places should simply offer smaller portions and boxes for leftovers.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, kitchen waste is actually the bigger half of the problem. A restaurant can start by measuring it: keeping one bin only for food thrown away during preparation shows very quickly which dishes are over-ordered. Smaller and more frequent deliveries keep vegetables fresh, and a short menu means fewer ingredients sitting in the fridge until Friday. Anything that is still safe at closing time can be sold cheaply through an app or given to the staff. None of this needs new technology; it needs one person whose job is to watch those numbers every week.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
لو الكلام قصير، ركّب:
شرطية: If restaurants measured their waste every week, most owners would be shocked by the number.
مبني للمجهول: In some countries, unsold food is collected by charities at the end of the day.
جملة وصل: Customers who pay for a buffet often take more than they can eat.

interactive.prompt: Some people believe that teenagers should have a part-time job while they are still at school. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You suggested a limit on the hours. Who do you think should control that limit: the family, the school, or the government?
interactive.model1_90: I agree, as long as the hours stay small. My first reason is that a job teaches things that school cannot. A teenager who works in a cafe learns to arrive on time, deal with a rude customer, and follow instructions from a stranger, and none of that appears in a textbook. My second reason is money. When you earn your own salary, even a small one, you finally understand what a phone or a pair of shoes really costs. My sister worked eight hours a week in a bookshop at seventeen, and she saved enough for her first laptop, which she still uses very carefully. However, studies must come first. I would say that six to ten hours a week is reasonable, and never during the exam period.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, I think the government should set the hard limit and families should decide inside it. A law is the only thing an employer cannot ignore, so a rule such as no more than twelve hours a week and nothing after nine at night for anyone under eighteen protects students whose parents need the income and might accept anything. Inside that limit, the family knows the child, the subjects, and the exam calendar, so they can say four hours or none at all. Schools should stay out of it, except to warn parents when the grades start falling.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
زيادات سريعة لو ما وصلت ١٢٠:
شرطية: If a student worked twenty hours a week, his grades would drop very quickly.
مبني للمجهول: In my country, working hours for young people are controlled by law.
جملة وصل: Teenagers who earn their own money usually spend it more carefully.

interactive.prompt: Some cities have banned private cars from the historic center. Do you think other cities should do the same? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You mentioned the shop owners. What about people who cannot walk far, such as elderly residents or parents with young children? How should a car-free center work for them?
interactive.model1_90: I think most cities should do the same, at least in their oldest streets. My first reason is safety and space. Historic centers were built for people walking, not for cars, and when the traffic is removed the same street suddenly holds cafes, markets, and children instead of parked metal. My second reason is that old buildings suffer from pollution and vibration, and repairs are expensive. I visited a city last year where the main square had been closed to traffic for ten years, and shop owners told me that their sales had increased, because visitors stay longer when a street is quiet. Cities must plan it properly, though: good buses, parking at the edge, and permits for residents and deliveries. Without that, a ban only moves the traffic one street away.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, a car-free center must have exceptions, or it becomes unfair. Residents with a medical card, and taxis carrying someone with limited mobility, should be allowed inside at any time, and drop-off points close to the main square make a short walk possible. Free electric shuttles every ten minutes would help older people and parents with strollers far more than a parking space would. Benches, shade, and clean toilets matter too, because distance feels completely different when you cannot rest. Designed like that, the center actually becomes easier for them, not harder.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
لو ناقصك كلمات، ضيف:
شرطية: If the city built parking at the edge first, most residents would accept the ban.
مبني للمجهول: Deliveries could be allowed only before eight in the morning.
جملة وصل: Shops that depend on tourists benefit the most from quiet streets.

interactive.prompt: Some universities have made attendance at lectures optional because all lectures are recorded. Do you agree with this change? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You supported the recordings. Do you think optional attendance changes the atmosphere of a course, or the relationship between students and professors?
interactive.model1_90: I agree that attendance should be optional at university level. My first reason is that students are adults who pay for their courses, and they usually know how they learn best. Some of them understand far more from a recording they can pause at midnight than from a hall with three hundred people at eight in the morning. My second reason is fairness. Students who work, who have children, or who live an hour away should not lose marks for something that has nothing to do with their knowledge. In my second year I broke my ankle and missed six weeks, and the recordings were the only reason I passed statistics. However, universities should keep attendance compulsory for labs, seminars, and group projects, because those sessions cannot be recorded in any useful way.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, honestly, yes, and this is the weak point in my argument. When only thirty students out of two hundred come, the room feels empty, the professor stops asking questions, and the lecture turns into a video with a small audience. Students also lose the short conversations after class, where you actually meet people and hear about jobs and projects. My suggestion is to change the format instead of forcing attendance: use the hall for discussion, problem solving, and guest speakers, and leave the explanation to the recording. People come when the room offers something the screen cannot.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
لو وقفت بدري:
شرطية: If lectures were not recorded, sick students would lose an entire month of material.
مبني للمجهول: In my university, every lecture is recorded and uploaded on the same day.
جملة وصل: Students who work in the morning depend completely on these recordings.

interactive.prompt: Some employers look at candidates' social media accounts before deciding whether to hire them. Do you think this is acceptable? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
interactive.followup: You mentioned professional accounts. Should candidates be told that their social media was checked, and should they get a chance to explain something the employer found?
interactive.model1_90: I think it is acceptable, but only within clear limits. On one side, a public account is public, and a company has a right to know if a candidate insults customers online or shares confidential information about a previous employer. That is a genuine risk, especially for someone who will represent the company in front of clients. On the other side, most of what people post has nothing to do with work: photos from a wedding, an opinion about a football team, a picture from ten years ago. Judging a candidate on those things is closer to prejudice than to recruitment. A friend of mine lost an opportunity because of a joke he had posted as a student, which says nothing about how well he writes code. So employers may look, but only at professional accounts.
interactive.model2_90: As I mentioned, yes on both points, and it would cost the company almost nothing. A single line in the job advertisement saying that public profiles may be reviewed makes the whole process honest, and it lets candidates check their own accounts first. If the employer then finds something worrying, the fair step is to ask about it in the interview, exactly as they would ask about a gap in a CV. People change, accounts get hacked, and a joke loses its context after ten years. One short question protects the candidate and gives the company much better information than a screenshot.
interactive.upgrade_ar:
زيادات لرفع العدد:
شرطية: If a company judged me by a post from ten years ago, I would not want to work there anyway.
مبني للمجهول: Personal accounts should not be used as part of a hiring decision.
جملة وصل: Candidates who work in public roles are watched more closely than others.

rts.prompt: Talk about a job you would like to try for one day.
bullets: What is the job, and why does it interest you?

Then there's the service itself, which I think is like a machine, with everyone shouting short instructions and nobody stopping. After that comes the cleaning, and probably a long list of things to order for the next day. The hardest part for me would honestly be the pressure. I'm quite slow and careful when I cook, and I don't like being watched, so having a manager checking every plate and a line of hungry customers waiting would be extremely stressful.

rts.model: The meal I make most often is grilled chicken with rice and a big salad, and it's honestly the only thing I cook really well. The ingredients are simple: chicken breast, brown rice, tomatoes, cucumber, lemon, olive oil, and a lot of black pepper. As for how I make it, I put the chicken in lemon, garlic, and yogurt for about an hour, then I grill it for around fifteen minutes while the rice is cooking. The salad takes five minutes, so everything is ready at the same time. About when I cook it, I usually make a large amount on Friday and keep it in the fridge for two or three days. The reason is that I get home late during the week, and if there's nothing ready I order fast food, which costs more and makes me feel heavy.

Sometimes I call my mother on speaker for ten minutes. If I could change one thing, I'd definitely take a train instead. Driving in heavy traffic makes me arrive at the office already tired and a little angry, and I'd much rather read or answer emails than watch brake lights. Unfortunately, there's no metro line near my area yet.

What I like about it is that the food is fresher and cheaper than in the supermarket, and you can actually see and smell what you're buying. I also like the atmosphere. The sellers know my face now, so they call me over and tell me which box arrived that morning, and that small conversation makes shopping feel less like a task.

rts.prompt: Talk about a time you repaired or fixed something yourself.

What I did was search on YouTube, and I found a video explaining that the problem is usually a small rubber washer inside. So I closed the main valve, took the tap apart with a wrench, took the old washer to the hardware shop to buy exactly the same size, and put everything back. It took me about an hour, mostly because I dropped a screw. Honestly, I felt proud, and a bit stupid for waiting six weeks. Since then I always look at a problem myself before I pay someone.
